# AI in the Real World: Data, Power, & Society

![Course Banner](images/course-banner.png)
**The above image was generated by Google Gemini EDU using the course summary to create a banner.**

---


## 📘 Course Description

This course explores the complex interplay between artificial intelligence (AI) and modern society. Students examine AI's applications, limitations, and implications across ethics, policy, economics, employment, and justice.

Through readings, case studies, and case designs, we critically analyze how these technologies influence and are influenced by our decisions and interactions. We will trace the uses of these technologies at various times and in various domains, including education, healthcare, and criminal justice, and consider their impacts on individuals and communities. 

Our aim is develop a nuanced understanding of AI's role in our society and to become **critical pragmatists** who can navigate the ethical, social, and political dimensions of AI in our personal and professional lives.

### Data, Tools, Practices, and Actions

We will use the Data, Tools, Practices, and Actions (DTPA) framework to explore these relationships. A diagram of the DTPA framework is shown below, illustrating the relationships between data, tools, practices, and actions. We include the progression from historical, to contemporary, to future-oriented case studies to help you understand how these relationships evolve over time.

![Diagram of the DTPA framework showing the relationships between data, tools, practices, and actions.](images/dtpa.png)
